source_name: Census American Community Survey, detailed tables
candidate_measures: B01001 population; B25003 tenure; B25010 household size; B25001/02 units and occupancy; B19001/13 income; B25064 rent; B25077 value; B25038 residence duration; B11007 older households; B22010 disability households; B07403/B07013 mobility.
access_and_verification: Official metadata read. Many 2024 tables and a harmonized historical panel already retained; additional tables require retrieval.
principal_limitation: Five-year estimates are overlapping periods, not annual observations. Retain margins of error and denominators; people, households and units differ.

source_name: Census Population Estimates, county components of change
temporal_coverage: Annual; vintage 2024 for 2020–2024; earlier vintages for history
candidate_measures: BIRTHS, DEATHS, DOMESTICMIG and INTERNATIONALMIG by year; population estimates.
access_and_verification: Official documentation read; data not newly acquired.
principal_limitation: Migration components are net flows. Do not substitute net migration for gross immigration or outmigration or splice revisions without reconciliation.

source_name: Census ACS Public Use Microdata Sample
geography: PUMA; derive county only where boundaries support it
candidate_measures: Household/person records; household income, age, disability, tenure, race/ethnicity, migration; person and household weights.
access_and_verification: Official access page read; microdata not acquired.
principal_limitation: No tract identifiers. Join persons to households before counting households with any vulnerable member; harmonize changing PUMA boundaries.

source_name: IRS county-to-county migration
candidate_measures: Incoming and outgoing returns, exemptions and adjusted gross income.
access_and_verification: Official data page read; additional acquisition candidate.
principal_limitation: Tax filers are a selected population; returns are not all households. Account for methodology changes, including 2022–2023.

source_name: Harris Central Appraisal District account and parcel downloads
candidate_measures: Account identifiers, land and improvement values, jurisdiction exemptions, property class, site area and parcel geometry.
access_and_verification: Official pages checked; 2024 raw archives already retained.
principal_limitation: Accounts, parcels, structures and households are not interchangeable. County aggregate market value is not a municipal taxable roll.

source_name: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer and map history
temporal_coverage: March 2026 local layer; historic effective dates must be reconstructed
candidate_measures: Effective flood zones, special flood hazard areas, map-change dates; overlay with parcel/structure locations.
access_and_verification: Official map-change instructions identified; existing local NFHL layer retained.
principal_limitation: A 2026 map cannot establish 2010–2024 historical exposure. Preliminary and effective maps differ; mapped zones omit some pluvial flooding.

source_name: USACE National Structure Inventory
candidate_measures: Structure occupancy, population estimates, structural characteristics and replacement/depreciated value inputs.
access_and_verification: Official technical documentation read; local SFHA extract retained.
principal_limitation: Modeled attributes require validation. Replacement cost is not sale price; the local SFHA subset cannot be used as the all-county denominator.

source_name: NOAA Storm Events bulk files
candidate_measures: Episode/event IDs, event type, start/end, property damage and narratives.
access_and_verification: Bulk source used in existing package; annual files retained.
principal_limitation: Several rows can represent one storm. Reported damage is incomplete and nominal; define event clusters and avoid adding overlapping losses.

source_name: HCFCD flood reports and Harris County Flood Warning System
candidate_measures: Rainfall, water levels, inundation exhibits, affected structures and major-flood chronology.
access_and_verification: Official report and gauge pages read; targeted raw series remain to acquire.
existing_local_material: data/raw/reused/harris_climate.csv.gz; hydro_physical.csv.gz provide related existing inputs.
principal_limitation: Gauge records need quality control; HCFCD riverine inundation exhibits are not all-mechanism flood footprints.

source_name: USGS Water Data APIs
temporal_coverage: Historical and current; varies by site
candidate_measures: Discharge, stage, peak flows and site metadata for flood-frequency analysis.
access_and_verification: Official API documentation and 2026 migration notice read; not downloaded for this report.
principal_limitation: Account for rating changes, regulation, missingness and nonstationarity; use the current API, not an assumed legacy endpoint.

source_name: Texas Water Development Board flood planning datasets
temporal_coverage: Dataset-specific; 2021 floodplain compilation and planning updates
candidate_measures: Floodplain estimates, flood exposure, regional planning GIS and flood-risk management projects.
access_and_verification: Official download and floodplain documentation pages read; candidate additional GIS.
principal_limitation: Compilation mixes sources and vintages. Keep pluvial, fluvial and coastal definitions and uncertainty explicit.

source_name: USGS CMIP6 LOCA2 and National Climate Change Viewer
candidate_measures: Temperature, precipitation and related climate summaries by model/scenario.
access_and_verification: Official dataset and viewer pages read; candidate download.
existing_local_material: No LOCA2 data identified in reviewed package.
principal_limitation: Climate projections do not directly measure a 0–100 impact index or flood losses. Translate through a hazard model and retain ensemble uncertainty.

source_name: NOAA relative sea-level trends and 2022 scenarios
temporal_coverage: Observed station series; projected scenario horizons
candidate_measures: Relative sea-level trend and scenario height trajectories for coastal boundary conditions.
access_and_verification: Official pages read; scenario files not acquired. NOAA page announces a September 30, 2026 site transition.
principal_limitation: Match vertical datum and reference period. Coastal boundary change does not supply countywide inland flood risk.

source_name: US Forest Service Wildfire Risk to Communities
candidate_measures: Burn probability, exposure and wildfire risk metrics for optional multi-hazard extension.
access_and_verification: Official project methods/download pages read; optional source only.
principal_limitation: Include only if wildfire is retained in Harris County scope. Do not sum incomparable wildfire and flood indices.

source_name: Houston-Galveston Area Council forecasts and land cover
temporal_coverage: Existing forecast/land-change files; horizon varies by edition
candidate_measures: Population, employment and household projections; development and land-use changes.
access_and_verification: Official pages checked; local forecast and changed-parcel extracts retained; some GIS uses a request form.
principal_limitation: Forecasts are scenario inputs, not observed demographic flows. Verify forecast edition, geography and baseline.

source_name: FHFA House Price Index datasets
candidate_measures: Repeat-sales home-price changes for appreciation and real-dollar sensitivity.
access_and_verification: Official dataset page read; candidate acquisition.
principal_limitation: An index is not a parcel value or disaster depreciation estimate. Mortgage/sample coverage limits representativeness.

source_name: HUD Comprehensive Housing Affordability Strategy data
geography: County, place, tract and other published areas
candidate_measures: Income-by-tenure counts, housing problems, cost burden and income-relative housing needs.
access_and_verification: Official download/documentation read; bulk files available; API requires a token.
principal_limitation: Does not identify actual affordable units currently available for relocating households.

source_name: HUD aggregated USPS vacancy data
candidate_measures: Residential/business addresses, vacant and no-stat addresses, vacancy duration.
access_and_verification: Official page read. Access restricted to eligible users; not an unrestricted public download.
principal_limitation: Vacant addresses are not necessarily habitable, offered for rent, affordable or hazard-safe.

source_name: Harris County HCD buyout guidelines and performance reports
temporal_coverage: Program-specific; 2024 Q3 and 2025 Q2 reports retained
candidate_measures: Eligibility, assistance components, program milestones, acquisitions and relocation reporting.
access_and_verification: Official program pages and linked June 2025 guidelines read; earlier quarterly reports retained.
principal_limitation: Program totals require reconciliation. A 2025 Q2 two-case discrepancy remains; relocation counts do not measure durable success.

source_name: HCFCD voluntary home buyout program
geography: HCFCD eligible areas and participating properties
candidate_measures: Voluntary program rules, eligibility, application stages and buyout-area context.
access_and_verification: Official pages read. Detailed longitudinal property records still require a request.
existing_local_material: Existing FEMA and HCD records are related, not substitutes for this program ledger.
principal_limitation: Interest submission is not completed application. Public buyout-area GIS gives approximate target-area centroids, not a completed-property inventory.

source_name: HCD public-records access route
geography: HCD cases, staff and program finances
temporal_coverage: Request 2010–2024, with later completion dates for censoring
candidate_measures: Proposed deidentified case-stage ledger, compensation components, support contacts, staffing, expenditures and outcome aggregates.
access_and_verification: Official request route verified. No request submitted; responsive fields and release are unconfirmed.
principal_limitation: This is a route to potential records, not evidence that each requested field exists. Retain rejected, withdrawn and pending cases.

source_name: HCFCD public-information access route
geography: HCFCD program, acquisition, land and infrastructure records
temporal_coverage: Request historical cohorts and 2024 opening balances
candidate_measures: Proposed acquisition GIS, stage dates, maintenance/restoration contracts, staff effort and decommissioning records.
access_and_verification: Official public-information request page read; no request submitted.
principal_limitation: Requested exports and monitoring may require staff compilation or may not exist; separate observed records from proposed collection.

source_name: Texas GLO HUD DRGR quarterly performance reports
temporal_coverage: Quarterly grant histories; local Harris buyout extracts retained
candidate_measures: Budget, obligations/disbursements, accomplishments, beneficiaries and activity narratives.
access_and_verification: Official reporting pages read; local financial/accomplishment/narrative files retained.
existing_local_material: data/raw/reused/glo_financial.csv.gz; glo_accomplishments.csv.gz; glo_beneficiaries.csv.gz; glo_narratives.csv.gz; glo_f31_1.xlsx; glo_f31_2.xlsx
principal_limitation: Activity totals and case completions differ. Do not add GLO, HCD and FEMA representations of the same award or property.

source_name: OpenFEMA HMA project-site inventories
temporal_coverage: API version-specific; retained v1 and older v4 extract
candidate_measures: Acquisition/mitigation project records, locations, status and program funding fields where present.
access_and_verification: Local API extracts and metadata verified in prior build; landing page returned 403 during source search.
principal_limitation: Version changes alter coverage. Inventory rows are not necessarily completed acquisitions or distinct households; deduplicate by stable project/site keys.

source_name: OpenFEMA NFIP claims and Individual Assistance/Housing Assistance
temporal_coverage: Historical panel coverage varies by source
candidate_measures: Insurance payments, claims and assistance/damage indicators in retained panel.
access_and_verification: Local harmonized inputs retained. FEMA landing page returned 403 during this review; original lineage retained in upstream files.
principal_limitation: Claims cover insured properties; assistance covers applicants. Neither is a complete loss denominator, and payouts are not direct retreat-program revenue.

source_name: Harris County adopted budgets and budget volumes
candidate_measures: Appropriations, authorized positions, revenues, service costs and capital planning.
access_and_verification: Official budget portal read; two budget PDFs already retained.
principal_limitation: Authorized positions are not filled buyout FTE; adopted appropriations are not spending or available cash.

source_name: Harris County Auditor annual comprehensive financial reports
candidate_measures: Actual revenues/expenditures, fund balances, transfers, tax data and long-term fiscal context.
access_and_verification: Official catalog and FY2024 report read; candidate acquisition.
existing_local_material: Budget PDFs provide related inputs, not audited equivalents.
principal_limitation: County, city, Flood Control District and special taxing districts have different boundaries and funds. Fiscal year differs from calendar year.

source_name: Harris County Commissioners Court agendas, minutes and votes
temporal_coverage: Dated meetings; current and archived systems
candidate_measures: Policy adoption, agreements, approvals, awards, public participation and decision milestones.
access_and_verification: Official calendar/archive pages read; additional document coding candidate.
principal_limitation: Votes and meetings can anchor milestones but are not direct measures of political will, trust or representative participation.

source_name: Harris County purchasing, contracts and procurement records
candidate_measures: Scope, staffing, unit prices, demolition/restoration/relocation services and completion dates.
access_and_verification: Official portal and linked Bonfire/GovQA routes verified; detailed invoice/effort exports not acquired.
principal_limitation: Bid amounts, awards, modifications and paid invoices differ; match eligible hectares, tasks and contract phase.

source_name: USAspending API and federal award transactions
candidate_measures: Award identifiers, action obligations, recipients, agencies and spending context.
access_and_verification: Official API documentation read; candidate supplementary download.
principal_limitation: Obligations are not cash outlays; prime/subawards can overlap. Match grants rather than sum county search results.

source_name: BLS Consumer Price Index
geography: Houston metropolitan area or national benchmark
temporal_coverage: Monthly/bimonthly or annual series depending geography
candidate_measures: Price index for converting nominal household/property expenditures to a common 2024-dollar convention.
access_and_verification: Official data and Houston release pages read; deflator not yet applied.
existing_local_material: Existing monetary series remain nominal unless explicitly labeled otherwise.
principal_limitation: CPI describes consumer prices, not construction/restoration input costs; test an appropriate sector deflator for contracts.

source_name: FEMA benefit-cost analysis guidance
candidate_measures: Discounting conventions and benefit-cost methods for eligible mitigation projects.
access_and_verification: Official policy located; PDF fetch was unsuccessful. Applicability/current rule must be checked against the award before use.
principal_limitation: Do not report one discount rate as universally current. Model social welfare costs and agency cash flows separately.

source_name: Rice Greater Houston Community Panel (GHCP)
geography: Greater Houston adult respondents; Harris subset/weights must be established
candidate_measures: Neighborhood cohesion/attachment, life satisfaction, psychological distress, social support and storm impacts; exact fields in report.
access_and_verification: Catalog and 248-page codebook read; codebook downloaded. Public-use data require a request form; no request submitted. Public files omit geocodes.
principal_limitation: Not a buyout participant panel. Confirm Harris geography, weights, longitudinal linkage and available waves. Suppressed values cannot be treated as observations.

source_name: Opportunity Insights Social Capital Atlas
geography: County and ZIP; some institution measures
candidate_measures: Economic connectedness, network cohesiveness, volunteering and civic organization density.
access_and_verification: Project/download pages and tutorial read; data not acquired.
principal_limitation: These are distinct network/community measures, not a longitudinal 0–100 social-capital stock or a relocation-effect coefficient.

source_name: Texas A&M IDRT / OneGulf buyout fiscal and social implications project
geography: Historical Harris County buyouts and destination block groups
temporal_coverage: Coverage years not verified from underlying data
candidate_measures: Public dashboard described as comparing origin/destination flood risk, vulnerability and relocation distances.
access_and_verification: Institutional project description verified; dashboard exists but underlying exports, completeness and reuse terms are unverified.
existing_local_material: No dataset identified in reviewed local files.
principal_limitation: Request data/provenance from the research team; dashboard visuals alone cannot establish relocation success or household-level longitudinal outcomes.

source_name: Texas A&M / Texas Appleseed Harris County Home Buyout Study, Phase 1
candidate_measures: Qualitative evidence on relocation, process fairness, communication, support needs, delays and social disruption.
access_and_verification: 72-page primary report read via web; local PDF download returned 403; underlying interview data access unverified.
principal_limitation: The methods describe interviews with 20 residents. Use for construct design and mechanism checks, not representative rates or causal coefficients.

source_name: Rice Texas Flood Registry
geography: Participating Houston-area residents; public aggregated products
candidate_measures: Flood exposure, displacement, recovery and health experience.
access_and_verification: Institutional page and catalog descriptions read; underlying records/precise access need confirmation.
principal_limitation: Self-selected participation and attrition limit population inference; separate registry aggregates from a probability sample.

source_name: Williams and Vaske place-attachment measurement study, USFS repository
geography: Measurement instrument; no Harris County observations
candidate_measures: Place identity and place dependence items for a locally adapted survey.
access_and_verification: Primary research repository and PDF identified/read.
principal_limitation: An established instrument supplies a measurement approach, not a Harris coefficient or an identity-based attachment score.

source_name: OECD Guidelines on Measuring Trust
candidate_measures: Institutional and interpersonal trust question modules; adapt specifically to buyout decision/process.
access_and_verification: Official publication page read; method source.
principal_limitation: General government/media trust cannot substitute for trust in this particular retreat process.

source_name: WHO-5 Well-Being Index
candidate_measures: Five-item self-reported wellbeing instrument for proposed follow-up measurement.
access_and_verification: Official instrument page read; no local survey administered.
existing_local_material: GHCP supplies alternative existing wellbeing measures.
principal_limitation: Choose one construct and scoring convention; do not mix WHO-5, life satisfaction and distress as if the same scale.

source_name: CDC PLACES
temporal_coverage: Annual releases; underlying survey years differ
candidate_measures: Modeled frequent mental distress, poor health and other health indicators.
access_and_verification: Official portal and measure definitions read; data not acquired.
principal_limitation: Small-area modeled prevalence is an ecological baseline, not an individual K6/WHO-5 score or a buyout treatment effect.

source_name: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index
candidate_measures: Socioeconomic, household, minority/language and housing/transportation vulnerability indicators and rankings.
access_and_verification: Official data/documentation read; optional comparator not newly acquired.
existing_local_material: Underlying ACS inputs already partly retained.
principal_limitation: Relative rank is not household vulnerability prevalence or an equity outcome. Harmonize historical geography and definitions.

source_name: SAMHSA National Substance Use and Mental Health Services Survey
geography: Treatment facilities and available published geographies
candidate_measures: Facility services and capacity-related characteristics for psychosocial-service context.
access_and_verification: Official datafiles page read; extract not acquired.
principal_limitation: Facility counts are not available buyout counselor FTE, appointments or program effectiveness.

source_name: Harris County Public Health reports and dashboards
candidate_measures: Community health needs, access barriers and health status for triangulation.
access_and_verification: Official reports page read; candidate reports identified.
principal_limitation: Confirm the population and geography of each report; a Houston-city assessment is not automatically countywide.

source_name: Texas Historical Commission Historic Sites Atlas
candidate_measures: Historic markers and National Register resources for exposure screening.
access_and_verification: Official data download and access explanations read; GIS not acquired.
principal_limitation: Sensitive archaeological records are restricted. Designations omit living cultural values; do not infer community significance solely from inventory presence.

source_name: HUD Tribal Directory Assessment Tool
temporal_coverage: Current tool; historical interest not a numeric time series
candidate_measures: Identify tribes with relevant interests and appropriate consultation contacts.
access_and_verification: Official tool and manual read; no consultation initiated.
principal_limitation: This is a consultation-routing tool, not a measure of attachment, trauma, leadership quality or rights.

source_name: HCFCD Watershed Environmental Baseline (WEB)
candidate_measures: Natural, cultural and physical watershed resources for ecological baseline and site screening.
access_and_verification: Official program description read; underlying GIS/monitoring availability needs confirmation/request.
principal_limitation: A program description is not an annual ecosystem-health dataset; record field protocols and survey dates.

source_name: HCFCD wetland mitigation banks and monitoring records
candidate_measures: Restoration/enhancement acreage, habitat treatments and possible monitoring/contract records.
access_and_verification: Official page read; detailed as-built costs/monitoring are request candidates.
existing_local_material: Local hcfcd_maintenance.pdf supplies qualitative context only.
principal_limitation: Mitigation credits are not cost per hectare. Bank projects differ from small buyout parcels; verify transferability.

source_name: USGS Annual National Land Cover Database
candidate_measures: Land cover, change and imperviousness for development and revegetation checks.
access_and_verification: Official access pages read; raster not newly downloaded.
existing_local_material: Existing hydro_static.csv.gz includes related static context.
principal_limitation: Small lots can be below effective resolution; land-cover change is not proof of funded restoration or ecological health.

source_name: US Fish and Wildlife Service National Wetlands Inventory
candidate_measures: Wetland extent and habitat classification for ecosystem-area denominators.
access_and_verification: Official download/mapper pages read; candidate GIS.
principal_limitation: Not an annual health series or a regulatory jurisdiction determination; preserve source imagery dates.

source_name: TCEQ surface-water quality data (SWQMIS)
candidate_measures: Water chemistry and biological observations, station metadata and water-quality indicators.
access_and_verification: Official download/data-management pages read; sampling-query link identified.
principal_limitation: Sparse stations and upstream influences complicate buyout-site attribution; match hydrology and sampling effort.

source_name: Natural Capital Project InVEST methods and data
candidate_measures: Carbon, habitat, water/nutrient, recreation and flood-benefit modeling inputs and methods.
access_and_verification: Official data/method pages read; method source, not an acquired Harris valuation table.
principal_limitation: Supply local biophysical inputs and counterfactuals. Values cannot simply be copied per hectare or added without checking overlap.

source_name: EPA EnviroAtlas
candidate_measures: Ecosystem-service, access and environmental context indicators.
access_and_verification: Official overview and ecosystem-service pages read; specific Harris layer coverage must be checked.
principal_limitation: Indicator availability varies. An ecosystem-service proxy does not directly measure annual dollar benefits.

source_name: 44 CFR Part 80, property acquisition and relocation for open space
candidate_measures: Acquisition and post-acquisition land-use constraints, including open-space restrictions.
access_and_verification: Official nine-page legal text read; use as a scenario-eligibility reference.
principal_limitation: Rules depend on funding program and award. Redevelopment choices in the generic guide cannot be assumed feasible on every acquired parcel.

source_name: Harris County Clerk real-property records
candidate_measures: Deeds, transfers, easements and recorded restrictions to verify acquisition and title milestones.
access_and_verification: Official search pages read; no bulk instrument acquisition performed.
existing_local_material: HCAD account links provide related parcel identifiers.
principal_limitation: Some copies/services may involve fees. Recording date is not initial application, move date or necessarily sale price.

source_name: FEMA Hazus Flood Model technical manual
candidate_measures: Depth-damage and loss estimation methods for structures and occupancy classes.
access_and_verification: Official manual located during research; local structure/depth inputs must be assembled.
existing_local_material: NSI and physical hazard inputs partly retained.
principal_limitation: Engineering loss curves are modeled priors requiring local checks; damage fraction is not probability of total destruction.

source_name: Ali shared system-dynamics guide and mind map
geography: Generic model requiring Harris County localization
temporal_coverage: DOCX guide; mind map dated October 15, 2024
candidate_measures: Equations, stocks/flows, scenario selectors, illustrative parameters, feedbacks and additional mind-map concepts.
access_and_verification: Both original files inspected; 215-entry dictionary reconciled against full guide.
existing_local_material: sources/Managed Retreat System Dynamics Model.docx; sources/Mind Map Oct 15 2024.pdf
principal_limitation: Conceptual specification, not an executed .mdl file or empirical evidence for its constants.

source_name: UT Austin Bureau of Economic Geology bay shoreline change
geography: Galveston/Trinity/East/West Bay shorelines, including relevant Harris frontage
temporal_coverage: Historical shoreline intervals; Galveston system update through 2022
candidate_measures: Shoreline transects, change distance and rate_myr; distinguish bay shoreline from open-Gulf projects.
access_and_verification: Official project page and GIS service metadata read; no GIS export acquired.
principal_limitation: Optional coastal-erosion component; local shoreline rate is not a countywide exposure index or future deterministic forecast.

source_name: Harris County Engineer floodplain management and permit records
geography: County permitting jurisdiction; city jurisdictions require separate coverage
candidate_measures: Potential development permits, elevation certificates, substantial-damage/improvement assessments and rebuilding decisions.
access_and_verification: Official program page read; underlying historical bulk records are a request candidate, not verified downloadable data.
existing_local_material: HCAD/land-change files provide existing complementary evidence.
principal_limitation: County permitting does not cover all incorporated municipalities; permit issuance is not construction completion or proven total destruction.

source_name: Census LEHD Origin-Destination Employment Statistics
geography: Census block home/workplace and origin-destination pairs
temporal_coverage: Annual; coverage varies by state/year; LODES 8 uses 2020 blocks
candidate_measures: Resident and workplace jobs, earnings/industry categories and home-work linkages for livelihood/access context.
access_and_verification: Official data page and technical-document metadata read; no new download.
existing_local_material: H-GAC employment forecasts provide related local material.
principal_limitation: Jobs and home-work linkages are not complete individual livelihood histories, observed commuting trips or evidence of post-buyout employment effects.

source_name: University of Richmond Mapping Inequality, Houston
geography: Historically graded Houston areas, not all Harris County
temporal_coverage: Historical HOLC-era maps and area descriptions
candidate_measures: Historical grading polygons and archival neighborhood descriptions as one component of inequity context.
access_and_verification: Houston catalog and download metadata identified in primary-site search; interactive page did not return readable content. Exports not acquired.
principal_limitation: Historic map coverage is incomplete and historically specific. It cannot supply a universal discrimination index or prove current individual treatment.

source_name: Mach et al., Managed retreat through voluntary buyouts of flood-prone properties
candidate_measures: Candidate national comparison for program geography, capacity, exposure and demographic patterns.
access_and_verification: Primary article indexed and abstract/method excerpt located; full-page access returned a browser check. Supplement/data access not verified.
existing_local_material: Existing OpenFEMA data provide a related independent source.
principal_limitation: Comparison-study lead, not a locally estimated behavioral/time-delay parameter. Assess methods, dates and duplication before use.

source_name: Addressing coordination problems in residential buyouts: experimental evidence
geography: Experimental study; external to this Harris County application
temporal_coverage: 2024 Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization article
candidate_measures: Candidate behavioral evidence on coordination in voluntary buyouts for lookup-function and mechanism review.
access_and_verification: Publisher title/abstract metadata located; full page returned 403. No numerical effect extracted; data availability unverified.
principal_limitation: Obtain and assess the full study before borrowing any parameter; experimental context and local field participation may differ.
